name: TWENTY-FOUR
description: Booleo is a two-player commercial strategy card game built around Boolean logic gates. Players build a logical pyramid from initial binary values and gate cards, aiming for the final output that matches their side.

content.text: Booleo is a two-player commercial strategy card game built around Boolean logic gates. Players build a logical pyramid from initial binary values and gate cards, aiming for the final output that matches their side.
Designed by Jonathan Brandt and Chris Kampf with Sean P. Dennis, Booleo was developed in 2008 and first published by Tessera Games LLC in 2009.
2 players use the table arrangement described for Booleo.
Dedicated 64-card Booleo deck of initial binary and Boolean logic gate cards
